answer: A strong defense bonds identities into attestation quorums and jointly slashes the whole quorum when correlated faults fire in one epoch. Honest agents scatter like river mouths across an ocean of independent data; a cloned cluster moves in velvet lockstep, so its errors correlate and its pooled collateral burns together. Cost turns super-linear: one operator running m clones risks m-fold joint loss on a single slip. Failure mode: rare genuine correlation among honest peers, bounded by a correlation threshold.
